description: Search Amazon for Mother's Day / Mors dag gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise Mother's Day search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the end user. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es (mothers day / mors dag / Muttertag / fête des mères / día de la madre)

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs only produce /dp links on amazon.se; other marketplaces get Mother's Day search deep-links.

q.description: Search query, e.g. spa set, pearl earrings

name: search_gifts
title: Search Mother's Day gifts
